chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. 'Abdullah narrated to us from Ya'qub b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Abi 'Umayr from Hisham b. Salim from Abu 'Abdillah Ja'far b. Muhammad al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said:
The feet of a false witness will not move from their place until the Fire becomes due for him.

key_terms.النار: the Fire - referring to Hellfire (Jahannam), the place of punishment in the afterlife
key_terms.شاهد الزور: false witness - one who gives false testimony, considered a major sin in Islamic law

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for bearing false witness in Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) warns that a person who bears false witness will face immediate divine consequence - their feet will not move before Hellfire is decreed for them. This hadith was narrated in the scholarly circles of 4th century Qom, where false testimony in legal disputes was a serious concern. The vivid imagery of feet being fixed emphasizes both the certainty and swiftness of divine punishment for this sin.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
